title: Choosing a Career
text:
Maria is a student at a university in Istanbul. She studies engineering, but she is not sure about her future job. Last year she visited a company and talked to an engineer. He showed her how he designs bridges. Maria liked the work very much.

Now Maria takes a short course every Saturday. The course teaches computer programming. She practises at home every evening. Her teacher says she has a good chance of getting a job next year.

questions.text: Why did Maria visit the company?
How does Maria feel about her future?
options: She is completely sure about it
She does not want to work
She is angry with her teacher

vocabulary.definition: a place where people study after high school
a person who designs and builds things such as bridges
a set of lessons on one subject
a possibility that something good will happen

paragraph_translations: Maria, İstanbul'da bir üniversitede öğrencidir. Mühendislik okuyor, ama gelecekteki işinden emin değil. Geçen yıl bir şirketi ziyaret etti ve bir mühendisle konuştu. Ona köprü nasıl tasarladığını gösterdi. Maria bu işi çok beğendi.
Şimdi Maria her cumartesi kısa bir kursa gidiyor. Kurs bilgisayar programlamayı öğretiyor. Her akşam evde pratik yapıyor. Öğretmeni, gelecek yıl iş bulma şansının iyi olduğunu söylüyor.
